g.text: "This instruction is only applied to 1 unit of 0054 per machine located at Printing side
a)Apply double face tape all over the edges of cladding
b)Facing to the furthest long edge of 0541_Table_V2
c)Installed on the outer surface of 0054
此说明仅适用于每台机器位于印刷侧的 1 个 0054 单元
a) 在覆层边缘粘贴双面胶带
b) 朝向 0541_Table_V2 的最长边
c) 安装在 0054 的外表面上
